newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-EVERTON SIGN DEFENDER PHELAN FROM CHELSEA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EVERTON SIGN DEFENDER PHELAN FROM CHELSEA.

text.p: Everton manager Joe Royle signed Chelsea defender Terry Phelan on Monday in an 850,000 pounds ($1.4 million) deal.
Royle moved in quickly for the experienced 29-year-old Ireland international as Andy Hinchcliffe is ruled out for the season because of a knee injury.
Phelan is expected to start training on Tuesday after agreeing a three-and-a-half year contract and could make his debut against Blackburn on Wednesday.
